title: Book a Free 30-Minute Discovery Session | Ingeniak
metaDescription: A free 1:1, 30-minute call for small business owners: we map your operation, spot opportunities, and you leave with concrete recommendations.
h1: 30 minutes to see your operation as it is, not as you think it is

secondaryCta.label: Message Kain
secondaryCta.waMessage: Hi, I'm coming from the English site (Discovery Session page) and have a question before booking.

faq.a: Yes. The 30 minutes cost nothing and we don't ask for a credit card. The call exists because diagnosing before quoting is the only serious way to work.

faq.q: Are you going to sell to me on the call?
faq.a: It's a discovery call: we map your operation and tell you what we see. At the end, if it makes sense, we share an implementation proposal. If it doesn't, we tell you that too.

faq.q: What should I prepare for the call?
faq.a: Nothing special. Knowing how your business runs day to day is enough. If you have numbers on hand, even better: the diagnosis gets more precise.
If your project makes sense for both sides, we prepare an implementation proposal with scope and timeline. You decide whether to move forward.
Yes, with at least 24 hours' notice. Message us on WhatsApp at +52 33 2101 7799 or email contacto@ingeniak.mx and we'll move it.

faq.q: What if my business is too small or too big?
faq.a: We work with small and midsize businesses of 3 to 40 employees in any industry. If you're outside that range, the call makes it clear in the first few minutes and we point you to the right option.
